class.name: GameplayCueTable
class.description: Each entry maps a cue tag to a [GameplayCueNotify] or a [PackedScene]. List tables in the [code]application/game_framework/gameplay_cue_tables[/code] project setting, or add one at runtime with [method GameplayCueManager.add_table]. A tag with no entry uses its nearest parent's: [code]Cue.Hit.Fire[/code] plays [code]Cue.Hit[/code]'s handler until it has its own.
